text.text_excerpt: I'm not sure why everybody doesn't love the Breaux, because it's my go-to regular grocery spot. Their prices are comparable to Rouses, and their grocery carts don't give me electric shocks (but that's a complaint for a different review...) Everything about Breaux is easy and consistent. Parking is always easy. There is never a wait to check out, and the checkers are more than competent. The selection isn't huge, but that's typical of a smaller store. I will give their beer section a shout out, they really have that part on lock. There are a few good recipes on their website and they actually have a pretty funny Instagram account too, check it out!

When I moved here and was getting a feel for my grocery store options, I wasn't sure about this place. I had heard that the selection was sparse and not great in comparison to Rouse's. For the most part that is true, but I don't think that's what Breaux Mart aspires to be. They are definitely an easy option if you live along the Magazine bus line and have anything you may need to pick up for tonight's dinner or even a quick lunch from their deli. Quite honestly, I usually run in here to get alcohol or beer. The prices are right and the beer selection has lots of good craft choices. I also am a big fan of their fresh squeezed OJ. So in a pinch, I'll definitely run in here for a few things....

I may be a bit biased as I live walking distance from this Breaux Mart, but they always seem to have exactly what I need. Sometimes their prices are higher than the other stores sometimes they are lower, but I don't mind thanks to the convenience. I find their meat prices some of the best around. They carry boars head deli meat at the deli counter, and a number of good looking prepared food. Their meatballs in the prepared food section are very good for pasta or sandwiches. I've also ordered sandwich trays from here and they are always fresh and easy. They also have the new Haydel's hand pies, and a large selection of halo top ice cream. Right after work around 5-6ish the lines can be rat...
